newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Tokyo Stock Exchange opens Singapore rep office.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Stock Exchange opens Singapore rep office.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) opened its third overseas representative office on Thursday in Singapore, in response to burgeoning growth and activity in Asian security markets, TSE officials said.

"Economic growth and development of the Asian region in recent years has been extremely remarkable, and accompanying this trend, financial activities have been very active," TSE President Mitsuhide Yamaguchi said at a reception for the new office's opening.
He also said efforts of each country toward the securities market have been increasing.
Yamaguchi added that the TSE had responded to related organisations and has been working toward contributing to the development of securities trading in the region.
The TSE already has representative offices in New York and London.

Seiji Adachi, the general manager of the Singapore office, said: "Singapore was considered a suitable location during our discussions due to easy access to regional markets such as Myanmar (Burma), Malaysia and Indonesia."

Some stock traders at the reception told Reuters the opening of the Japanese office had been much awaited as business from Japanese investors has been rising, and this was a necessary step for the TSE to maintain business ties with overseas Japanese investors.
